content: यन्त्रकः [यन्त्र्-ण्वुल्] .²1 One well acquainted with machinery. .²2 A mechanist; <ls>Rām. 2. 80. 1</ls> (<ab>com.</ab> यन्त्रका जलप्रवाहादियन्त्रणसमर्थाः). .²3 A restrainer, controller, subduer. .{@-कम्@} .²1 A bandage (in <ab>medic.</ab>). .²2 A turnerʼs wheel or lathe. .²3 A hand-mill. .²4 A sack; निधीयमाने भरभाजि यन्त्रके <ls>Śi. 12. 9</ls>.
